opening.text: Boulder in gold, Zip in teal. The Rush Arena rivals are off!

next.text: A fresh scoreline, a fresh chance. Here we go again!

halfTime.text: That's halftime. The teams swap ends, and the score carries over.

halfFeature.text: Half time! Take another look at one of my favorite moments.

secondHalf.text: The teams are back in motion. Second half underway!

finalWin.text: There's the final whistle! One more match coming right up.

finalDraw.text: All square at full time. They'll get another shot in the next match!

goalOne.text: It's in! Listen to that crowd!

goalTwo.text: There it is! That one found the back of the net!

goalThree.text: What a finish! The keeper had a lot to cover there.

equalizer.text: We're level again! This match just came to life.

ownGoal.text: Oh, that's an own goal. A tough bounce for the defending side.

saveOne.text: What a stop! The keeper had to move fast for that one.

saveTwo.text: The keeper gets there in time! Play goes on.

post.text: Off the frame of the goal! Everybody's chasing the rebound.

shotOne.text: They've had a go! Keep an eye on the ball.

shotTwo.text: There's the shot. The keeper is tracking it.

intercept.text: Read the pass perfectly. Here's a chance to break the other way.

tackle.text: Clean challenge! They're going the other way now.

pass.text: Quick passing opens up space. Watch the runners off the ball.

distribution.text: The keeper gets it moving again. The team spreads out to receive.

lastMinute.text: One minute left in this match. There's still time for one more chance!

lastMinuteLevel.text: One minute left and they're still level. Who's got one more trick?

oneGoalLeft.text: One goal between them with a minute left. Nobody can relax yet.

openingDuel.text: Boulder loves a big finish. Zip likes to leave you guessing.

boulderShot.text: Boulder winds up. Here comes the big swing!

zipShot.text: Zip found a gap! Quick turn, quick shot.

boulderGoal.text: Boulder scores! And there's his grand little bow.

zipGoal.text: Zip slips it in! He makes that look like a magic trick.

boulderPayback.text: Boulder remembers the last save. This time his bow is right on cue!

zipPayback.text: The keeper stopped Zip earlier. This time the trick worked!

boulderStretch.text: Boulder started celebrating. Now he's pretending it was a stretch.

zipHeadsUp.text: That nearly fooled the keeper. Zip's grin just went sideways.

mittsSave.text: Mitts gets to it! Those big gloves had the last word.

patchSave.text: Patch shuts the door! No way through that time.

mittsAgain.text: Mitts has seen that trick before. Same answer from those gloves.

patchAgain.text: Patch wins that little rematch. The shot looked good for a second.

boulderPost.text: Boulder, meet the post. I think it just said hello back.

zipPost.text: Zip gives the post a second look. Yes, Zip, it's still there.

postSecond.text: Off the post. The ball is back in play!

zipSteals.text: Zip nicks it away! Look how quickly play turns around.

boulderSteals.text: Boulder spotted the chance and took it. Nice clean steal.

tradeSteals.text: There goes the ball the other way again. These two keep trading tricks.

boulderFooled.text: Boulder's checking his feet. The ball has already gone!

zipFooled.text: For once, Zip is the one looking around for the ball.

lateGoal.text: That's a huge goal this late in the match!

lateEqualizer.text: And they're level with the clock running down! What a finish.

leadChange.text: They've turned it around and taken the lead!

saveBreak.text: No goal there. That save deserves a cheer of its own.

woodworkBreak.text: That was so close. The post had other plans.

quietBuild.text: Look at the players out wide. They're trying to make a gap.

boulderAside.speaker: BOULDER
boulderAside.text: Nice save. I'll take another swing!

boulderStretchAside.speaker: BOULDER
boulderStretchAside.text: Obviously, that was my warm-up stretch.

zipWaveAside.speaker: ZIP
zipWaveAside.text: Oh! Hello. I was just waving.

zipPostAside.speaker: ZIP
zipPostAside.text: Did that post just talk to me?

scruffRecap.text: Zip is Scruff's captain. See the mint scarf? He's always looking for a trick.

roundhouseRecap.text: That's Boulder in the orange headband. He's the Roundhouse captain.

zipMittsRecap.text: Corner of your eye on Zip and Mitts. They've already tested each other this match.

boulderPatchRecap.text: Boulder and Patch have already faced off. Let's see who wins the next one.

saveReplay.text: Look at the keeper here. Watch those gloves on the replay.

postReplay.text: Watch this bounce. The post had a big say in that play.

stealReplay.text: Watch how fast they turn this steal into a run.

backInIt.text: They've pulled one back. Now there's something to chase.

boulderWelcomeBack.speaker: BOULDER
boulderWelcomeBack.text: Back for another? So am I!

zipWelcomeBack.speaker: ZIP
zipWelcomeBack.text: Ready? I've got one more idea.

mittsTeamCall.text: Go wide. I've got your back.

mittsRivalCall.text: These gloves have a mind of their own!

mittsRivalReply.text: Fair play. My gloves want a rematch.

pipTeamCall.text: See that little gap? Let's use it!

pipRivalCall.text: I saw that coming. Double goggles!

pipRivalReply.text: Good move. I'll solve it next time.

sunnyTeamCall.text: Come on! Let's light up this wing.

sunnyRivalCall.text: Surprise! Even my flower saw that one.

sunnyRivalReply.text: Nice one! I've still got a surprise.

doodleTeamReply.text: Right with you. I'll add the squiggle.

doodleRivalCall.text: That's one way to redraw your plan!

doodleRivalReply.text: Nice. Time to draw up plan B.

boulderTeamCall.text: Come on! Let's make this one big.

boulderTeamReply.text: Right behind you! Well, very loudly.

boulderRivalCall.text: Did you see that? I almost bowed.

boulderRivalReply.text: Nice move. Save a bow for me!

patchTeamCall.text: Chin up! Let's get this moving.

patchRivalCall.text: Ooh, close! Got any more like that?

patchRivalReply.text: You've got this round. I'll bounce back!

crankTeamCall.text: Go ahead. The wall's right behind you.

crankTeamReply.text: On it. This wall has wheels.

crankRivalCall.text: That was fun. Want another go?

crankRivalReply.text: I'll give you that. One more, then.

dashTeamCall.text: Ready? My shoes are getting jumpy.

dashTeamReply.text: With you! My shoes heard everything.

dashRivalReply.text: You got me. Hang on, my laces are waking up!

tangleTeamCall.text: Let's build a way around them.

tangleRivalCall.text: That worked! Want to try a new trick?

tangleRivalReply.text: Good one! I'll have to invent something.

zipTeamCall.text: Come on! I've got a little trick.

zipTeamReply.text: I'm in. I'll bring the sneaky bit.

zipRivalCall.text: Ta-da! Want to see me do it again?

zipRivalReply.text: Ooh, good trick. I've got another one.

openingAlt1.text: Welcome to Rush Arena! Gold and teal, let's play!

openingAlt2.text: Ready, rivals? Ready, fans? It's kickoff time!

openingAlt3.text: Boots tied? Gloves on? Here come the Rush Arena rivals!

nextAlt1.text: Fresh match! Everybody gets another go.

nextAlt2.text: New whistle, clean scoreboard. Let the next round begin!

nextAlt3.text: Reset the score and wake up those football boots!

halfTimeAlt1.text: Time for a breather! They'll switch ends and keep that score.

halfTimeAlt2.text: Half time! Even the football gets a little rest.

halfTimeAlt3.text: That's the break. Same score, new ends when we return.

halfFeatureAlt1.text: Half time! Here's one play worth a second peek.

halfFeatureAlt2.text: Freeze those boots. We've got a replay to watch!

halfFeatureAlt3.text: Before they swap ends, let's watch that moment again.

secondHalfAlt1.text: Back on the pitch! The second half is rolling.

secondHalfAlt2.text: Gloves up, boots ready. Here comes half number two!

secondHalfAlt3.text: They're playing toward the other ends now. Away we go!

finalWinAlt1.text: That's the final whistle! See the winning side celebrate.

finalWinAlt2.text: Boots down! We have a winner at Rush Arena.

finalWinAlt3.text: Game over! A new match is just around the corner.

finalDrawAlt1.text: Same score on both sides! They'll settle it another time.

finalDrawAlt2.text: The whistle says that's a tie. Both teams get a cheer!

finalDrawAlt3.text: All level at the end. Who knew one football could cause such fuss?

goalOneAlt1.text: Goal! That net just did a little dance!

goalOneAlt2.text: It's in! Save room for the celebration!

goalOneAlt3.text: Goal! The ball is in and the crowd is up!

goalOneAlt4.text: Boom! That one's worth a wiggle!

goalTwoAlt1.text: In it goes! Wave those flags!

goalTwoAlt2.text: That's a goal! Look at those happy boots!

goalTwoAlt3.text: The ball hits the net. Here comes the happy dance!

goalThreeAlt1.text: What a finish! The net couldn't keep still.

goalThreeAlt2.text: That one's in! No wonder the stand is bouncing.

goalThreeAlt3.text: Goal! Look at that team light up!

equalizerAlt1.text: Goal, and we're level! It's anybody's match again.

equalizerAlt2.text: The scoreboard just matched its socks. We're all square!

equalizerAlt3.text: Same score on both sides! Who'll pull ahead now?

lateEqualizerAlt1.text: Just in time! That goal makes it a tie again.

lateEqualizerAlt2.text: Level, with time running out! What a twist!

lateEqualizerAlt3.text: Right at the end, they pull level! Hold on to your hats!

lateGoalAlt1.text: Late goal! They saved a surprise for the end!

lateGoalAlt2.text: Time's nearly up, and in it goes!

lateGoalAlt3.text: There's a goal right near the finish! What a twist!

leadChangeAlt1.text: New leader! The scoreboard has flipped!

leadChangeAlt2.text: In it goes, and now they're in front!

leadChangeAlt3.text: One more goal, and the lead changes sides!

backInItAlt1.text: They get one back! We have a chase on our hands.

backInItAlt2.text: One back on the board! This match has more in store.

backInItAlt3.text: That's a goal back! They're still in this.

ownGoalAlt1.text: Oh crumbs! That bounce took it into their own net.

ownGoalAlt2.text: Oops, wrong net. Shake it off and go again!

ownGoalAlt3.text: An own goal! Sometimes the ball writes its own jokes.

boulderGoalAlt1.text: Boulder scores! Make room for that big bow!

boulderGoalAlt2.text: Big kick, big goal! Take your bow, Boulder.

zipGoalAlt1.text: Zip scores! Turn that scarf into a victory flag!

zipGoalAlt2.text: Ta-da! Zip's trick ends up in the net!

mittsGoal.text: Mitts scores! A goal from the keeper!

mittsGoalAlt1.text: The keeper gets a goal of his own! Way to go, Mitts!

pipGoal.text: Pip scores! The goggles found a way!

pipGoalAlt1.text: Goal for Pip! That was a puzzle with a very loud answer.

sunnyGoal.text: Sunny scores! That flower's going to bounce!

sunnyGoalAlt1.text: Goal for Sunny! The whole stand just brightened up.

doodleGoal.text: Doodle scores! Put a big circle around that one.

doodleGoalAlt1.text: Doodle adds a little dot to the scoreboard. It's a goal!

patchGoal.text: Patch scores! The keeper can finish too!

patchGoalAlt1.text: Patch puts it in! Somebody tell those gloves!

crankGoal.text: Goal for Crank! The Wall can score too!

crankGoalAlt1.text: Crank scores! Even those ear pads heard that cheer.

dashGoal.text: Dash gets the goal! Now see if the shoes can stop!

dashGoalAlt1.text: Dash scores! Even the quiff is celebrating!

tangleGoal.text: Tangle works it out! That one's in the net!

tangleGoalAlt1.text: Goal for Tangle! Tie a bow around that finish!

postAlt1.text: Clang! The goal frame sends it back!

postAlt2.text: That hit the frame! The ball's still out there.

postAlt3.text: Off the woodwork! The ball took a noisy detour.

postAlt4.text: The goal frame says no. Watch the bounce!

woodworkBreakAlt1.text: Ping! So close. Even the post sounded surprised.

woodworkBreakAlt2.text: The frame had a vote, and the vote was clang!

woodworkBreakAlt3.text: Oh, that rattle! The net is still waiting.

saveOneAlt1.text: What a save! Those gloves earned a cheer.

saveOneAlt2.text: The keeper is there! That ball had somewhere else in mind.

saveOneAlt3.text: Stopped! Give the keeper a little glove clap.

saveTwoAlt1.text: No way through on that shot! The keeper read it.

saveTwoAlt2.text: Save! The keeper gets the last word again.

saveTwoAlt3.text: That shot was looking dangerous. Then came the keeper!

diveSave.text: Full stretch! What a diving save!

diveSaveAlt1.text: The keeper takes off sideways and makes the stop!

diveSaveAlt2.text: Gloves out, feet off the grass. Diving save!

diveSaveAlt3.text: That dive looked like a leap across a puddle!

tipSave.text: A fingertip save! Just enough glove on it.

tipSaveAlt1.text: What a touch! The keeper gets a fingertip there.

tipSaveAlt2.text: Tip! One little touch makes a big difference.

tipSaveAlt3.text: The keeper stretches high and changes the ball's mind!

scoopSave.text: Down low! The keeper makes the scoop.

scoopSaveAlt1.text: The keeper gets low and scoops that shot away.

scoopSaveAlt2.text: A little dip, a big save! Look how low the keeper gets.

scoopSaveAlt3.text: Quick gloves near the grass. Well scooped!

blockSave.text: Big block! The keeper gets right behind that shot.

blockSaveAlt1.text: Save! The keeper makes a wall of gloves and boots.

blockSaveAlt2.text: The keeper spreads out and blocks the way!

blockSaveAlt3.text: That shot met a whole keeper in its path.

heldSave.text: Safe in the gloves! That ball can stop wiggling now.

heldSaveAlt1.text: Held tight! The keeper keeps it under control.

heldSaveAlt2.text: The keeper hangs on! A good moment for a deep breath.

heldSaveAlt3.text: Two gloves around it. Safe and sound!

shotOneAlt1.text: Here comes a shot! Keep your eyes on the ball.

shotOneAlt2.text: A swing and a shot! Where's it headed?

shotOneAlt3.text: Boot meets ball! That one's on its way.

shotTwoAlt1.text: There's the strike! Will the keeper get there?

shotTwoAlt2.text: They've had a shot. Watch the keeper now!

shotTwoAlt3.text: Someone fancied a shot. Let's follow it!

boulderShotAlt1.text: Boulder shoots! I think the boot woke up first.

boulderShotAlt2.text: Big swing from Boulder! Watch where it goes.

zipShotAlt1.text: Zip takes a shot! He kept that one up his sleeve.

zipShotAlt2.text: Zip shoots! Blink after the ball lands.

longShot.text: A shot from way out! That's a long ride for the ball.

longShotAlt1.text: They've tried one from distance! Look at it go.

longShotAlt2.text: That's a long-range shot. Is the keeper ready?

longShotAlt3.text: Wallop! A shot from out there needs a real swing!

loftPass.text: Up it goes! A little holiday for the football.

loftPassAlt1.text: Lofted pass! Find the runner under that ball.

loftPassAlt2.text: That pass went upstairs. Watch where it comes down.

loftPassAlt3.text: High pass! There's a teammate chasing it.

switchPass.text: Over to the other wing! That's a big switch.

switchPassAlt1.text: The ball is crossing the pitch. Look for the far-side runner.

switchPassAlt2.text: A switch of play! Everyone has to turn their heads.

switchPassAlt3.text: Way across it goes! The other side of the pitch just woke up.

drivePass.text: Zing! That's a firm pass into space.

drivePassAlt1.text: Driven pass! See who can meet it.

drivePassAlt2.text: A quick low ball! The runner has to get there.

passAlt1.text: Little passes, little gaps. Watch the space open up.

passAlt2.text: Watch the teammate moving for the next pass.

passAlt3.text: A pass to keep things moving. Where's the next gap?

interceptAlt1.text: Cut out the pass! Good reading of the play.

interceptAlt2.text: Wrong address! That pass found a rival.

interceptAlt3.text: The defender stepped in early and picked it off.

tackleAlt1.text: Good challenge! The ball changes feet.

tackleAlt2.text: A quick poke and it's theirs. Neat tackle!

tackleAlt3.text: Tackle won! Now the other side gets a turn.

distributionAlt1.text: The keeper starts the next move. Look for a teammate out wide.

distributionAlt2.text: Out it goes from the keeper! The team can build again.

distributionAlt3.text: The keeper sends it on its way. Here comes the next play.

lastMinuteAlt1.text: One minute to go! Let's see who has a final surprise.

lastMinuteAlt2.text: We're into the last minute. Keep those boots moving!

lastMinuteAlt3.text: Sixty seconds left. One more chance, maybe?

lastMinuteLevelAlt1.text: One minute left, still level. This could go either way!

lastMinuteLevelAlt2.text: All square with sixty seconds to play. Who's got a last trick?

lastMinuteLevelAlt3.text: The score is tied and the clock is ticking. One minute!

oneGoalLeftAlt1.text: One goal the difference, one minute on the clock!

oneGoalLeftAlt2.text: Sixty seconds left and only one goal in it. Hang on!

oneGoalLeftAlt3.text: One minute to go. The next goal could change everything.

saveReplayAlt1.text: Watch the keeper again. Look at the timing on that stop.

saveReplayAlt2.text: Here comes the replay! Keep your eyes on those gloves.

saveReplayAlt3.text: Back it up a little. That save is worth seeing twice.

postReplayAlt1.text: Watch the goal frame on this replay. Here comes the clang!

postReplayAlt2.text: Here's that rebound again. See where the ball bounces!

postReplayAlt3.text: A second peek at the moment the goal frame joined in.

stealReplayAlt1.text: Watch the defender step in on this replay.

stealReplayAlt2.text: How did the ball change teams so fast? Take another look.

stealReplayAlt3.text: Here's the steal again. Follow the player who steps across.

mittsTeamCallAlt1.text: Show me your run. I'll keep the back door shut.

mittsTeamCallAlt2.text: Go on, out wide! My gloves have the middle.

mittsTeamCallAlt3.text: That's for you! Let the ball do the running.

mittsTeamReplyAlt1.text: Safe here. You go on, I'll cover.

mittsRivalCallAlt1.text: My gloves say hello. Rather loudly!

mittsRivalCallAlt2.text: Try that again! My gloves are paying attention.

mittsRivalCallAlt3.text: That was close. You made my helmet wobble!

mittsRivalReplyAlt1.text: Good one. We'll try that again, eh?

mittsRivalReplyAlt2.text: Fair enough! The gloves are staying on.

pipTeamCallAlt1.text: I've found a gap exactly one football wide!

pipTeamCallAlt2.text: Follow that little space. I did the math!

pipTeamCallAlt3.text: Here's a clue. The open bit is over there!

pipTeamReplyAlt1.text: Puzzle piece found! I'm with you.

pipTeamReplyAlt2.text: Yep, that fits! Keep it moving.

pipRivalCallAlt1.text: I think I've solved that move. One more test?

pipRivalCallAlt2.text: My goggles saw the tiny gap first!

pipRivalCallAlt3.text: Good puzzle! Have you got a harder one?

pipRivalReplyAlt1.text: Oh! I'll need a bigger thinking face.

pipRivalReplyAlt2.text: You found the answer first. Good one!

sunnyTeamCallAlt1.text: Race you to the sunny side!

sunnyTeamCallAlt2.text: Let's go, teammate! Make that wing glow.

sunnyTeamCallAlt3.text: Here you go! My flower votes for a run.

sunnyTeamReplyAlt1.text: On it! This flower can keep up.

sunnyTeamReplyAlt2.text: Right there with you. Let's go!

sunnyRivalCallAlt1.text: Bet my flower can spot your next trick!

sunnyRivalCallAlt2.text: Ooh, that was close. Fancy another race?

sunnyRivalCallAlt3.text: My flower just did a happy wiggle!

sunnyRivalReplyAlt1.text: Good one! Still smiling over here.

sunnyRivalReplyAlt2.text: You got me! The flower wants a rematch.

doodleTeamCallAlt1.text: Follow the squiggle! That's my whole plan.

doodleTeamCallAlt2.text: Here's a pass with a little curl on it.

doodleTeamCallAlt3.text: Let's draw a line right through that gap!

doodleTeamReplyAlt1.text: Got the idea! I'll add a wiggle.

doodleTeamReplyAlt2.text: Yep. Let's put a dot on the end of that.

doodleRivalCallAlt1.text: That's a good scribble. I've got one too!

doodleRivalCallAlt2.text: One little line and the whole picture changes.

doodleRivalCallAlt3.text: Think you can draw your way past me?

doodleRivalReplyAlt1.text: I like it. I might borrow that squiggle.

doodleRivalReplyAlt2.text: You got me. Where did I leave my eraser?

boulderTeamCallAlt1.text: Take it! I'll make room for the grand bit.

boulderTeamCallAlt2.text: Go for it! I'll be the noisy one behind you.

boulderTeamCallAlt3.text: This way, team! Big plan, little pass.

boulderTeamReplyAlt1.text: I hear you! Even my headband heard you.

boulderTeamReplyAlt2.text: Count me in. I'll save the bow for later.

boulderRivalCallAlt1.text: Round two? I can do this all afternoon!

boulderRivalCallAlt2.text: That was close enough to make me practice my bow.

boulderRivalCallAlt3.text: Have you got another move? I like a surprise!

boulderRivalReplyAlt2.text: Well played. You can have half a bow.

patchTeamCallAlt1.text: Out you go! I've patched up the back.

patchTeamCallAlt2.text: Let's go again. We've still got a whole pitch!

patchTeamCallAlt3.text: Take it away! I'll watch behind you.

patchTeamReplyAlt1.text: Got your back! Stitch by stitch.

patchTeamReplyAlt2.text: Ready here. Let's give it another go.

patchRivalCallAlt1.text: Ooh! You nearly pulled a stitch there.

patchRivalCallAlt2.text: Good try! I've still got one more bounce.

patchRivalCallAlt3.text: Want another go? My patch is still attached!

patchRivalReplyAlt1.text: Fair play. I'll sew up that gap.

patchRivalReplyAlt2.text: You got me that time. Time to bounce back!

crankTeamCallAlt1.text: Off you go. I'll stay where the wall goes.

crankTeamCallAlt2.text: Take it upfield. I'll mind the gap.

crankTeamCallAlt3.text: Give it a run. I'll keep the door closed.

crankTeamReplyAlt2.text: I'm here. Let's keep it simple.

crankRivalCallAlt1.text: Got another route? This one is closed.

crankRivalCallAlt2.text: You almost got past the wall that time.

crankRivalCallAlt3.text: I'm still here. Fancy another try?

crankRivalReplyAlt1.text: Good move. I'll shut that gap next time.

crankRivalReplyAlt2.text: All right. That's one for you.

dashTeamCallAlt1.text: Send me after it! I'm already half running.

dashTeamCallAlt2.text: Let's go! These boots have ants in them.

dashTeamCallAlt3.text: Keep moving! I'll meet you down the line.

dashTeamReplyAlt1.text: Yep! I'm right on your heels.

dashRivalCallAlt1.text: Whoosh! Did my quiff ruffle yours?

dashRivalCallAlt2.text: That was fast. Wanna try even faster?

dashRivalCallAlt3.text: My boots are ready for another lap!

dashRivalReplyAlt1.text: Nice turn! My feet are still catching up.

dashRivalReplyAlt2.text: Good move! I'll run that back.

tangleTeamCallAlt1.text: I've got a plan with two moving parts. You and me!

tangleTeamCallAlt2.text: Let's try a little turn through there.

tangleTeamCallAlt3.text: Send it on. I'm working on part two!

tangleTeamReplyAlt1.text: Plan received. Bow is in position.

tangleRivalCallAlt1.text: That worked! My bow nearly came undone.

tangleRivalCallAlt2.text: Try the other way. I'll start thinking up a new plan!

tangleRivalCallAlt3.text: This game needs more gears. Shall we go again?

tangleRivalReplyAlt1.text: Clever! I'll put that in my notebook.

tangleRivalReplyAlt2.text: Good trick. I'll build a way around it.

zipTeamCallAlt1.text: Over to you! I'll hide the next trick up my scarf.

zipTeamCallAlt2.text: This way. Nobody expects the little pass!

zipTeamCallAlt3.text: Watch this bit. The surprise comes after.

zipTeamReplyAlt1.text: Got it. Sneaky feet switched on.

zipTeamReplyAlt2.text: I'm with you. Ta-da comes later.

zipRivalCallAlt1.text: Ta-da! The secret was in the footwork.

zipRivalCallAlt2.text: That was close! Want to see another trick?

zipRivalCallAlt3.text: I think my scarf saw that one before I did.

zipRivalReplyAlt1.text: Ooh, you got me. Fair and square!

zipRivalReplyAlt2.text: Good trick. Can I have the next turn?
